# MemeTorrent / FutureT3ch developer APIs

Base: https://memetorrent.futuret3ch.com.au
Docs: https://memetorrent.futuret3ch.com.au/developers/docs
CLI:  https://memetorrent.futuret3ch.com.au/cli/mt.js

## Live (keyless)
GET /api/v1/status
GET /api/v1/cryptocurrency/quotes/latest?symbol=MT
GET /api/v1/cryptocurrency/listings/latest
GET /api/v1/cryptocurrency/ohlcv?interval=1h
GET /api/v1/token/{mint}
GET /api/v1/token/{mint}/holders
GET /api/v1/token/{mint}/chart?range=24h
GET /api/v1/pool/{address}
GET /api/v1/chain/info

Envelope: { status: { timestamp, error_code }, data }

$MT mint: ELywDcVX2WumHm4xEfqF8NdEKaeGCAaq9JmwtjE8pump
Raydium pool: E3kdauLD47xLHAisLuvGTAnqD5MWWJojJYNMCoEvTHi7
